theme_balance: Content shows strong clustering around operational pain points (agency failures, speed-to-lead, paid ads ROI) with 4-5 pieces each, suggesting these are top-of-mind frustrations. Moderate representation in strategic areas (local SEO, content strategy, AI trends) with 2-3 pieces indicates emerging interest but less urgency. Notable gap in tactical 'how-to' content — most pieces are problem-focused or high-level case studies rather than step-by-step implementation guides. The duplication of the Google Ads failure story (5 times) suggests this is a critical pain point worth developing a comprehensive content cluster around. Overall balance skews toward identifying problems rather than solving them, creating opportunity for solution-oriented content.
